pageDescription: Showcase of reusable UI components built with the portfolio's Feature-Sliced Design architecture.
heading: UI components showcase
buttonsDescription: Interactive actions with 44px touch targets, hard shadow state progression and a muted disabled treatment.
techPillsDescription: Technology labels in the four card and stack combinations. Width is minimum-driven so long translated labels never clip.
socialDescription: Compact actions for social and contact destinations.
linksDescription: Links designed for use inside paragraphs and supporting copy.
avatarsDescription: Profile images rendered with the supported component sizes.
badgesDescription: Status and technology labels using the supported visual variants.
containersDescription: Responsive content container with consistent maximum width and centering.
containerBody: This SectionContainer keeps demonstration content aligned with the portfolio layout.
wrappingTitle: A long section title that wraps on narrow screens
contentPanelsDescription: Visual role variants with content-driven heights: long copy grows vertically instead of clipping.
contentPanelBody: This Content Panel keeps demonstration copy inside the approved border, shadow and spacing contract.
editorialCardsDescription: One primitive renders blog and devlog previews with localized type labels and a bottom-anchored call to action.
editorialCardBody: A short summary describing the linked article or patch notes entry.
